title: hoya wallichii
intro: Hoya wallichii, commonly known as the Wax Heart or Kerala Hoya, is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. It is known for its unique, waxy, heart-shaped leaves and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing stress and promoting relaxation, making it a popular choice for aromatherapy and herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of Hoya wallichii include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
